entry.author: Eastern Institute Of Technology
entry.summary:
From classroom learning to real‑world coaching — building confident leaders in the exercise industry .
 
We're excited to share this kōrero with Blaze Stafford and Joe Tangira, two proud graduates of the NZ Certificate in Exercise (Level 4) who are now out in the community helping others move, grow, and thrive.

In this video, Blaze and Joe talk about what inspired them to study exercise, the hands‑on learning that shaped their skills, and how the programme gave them the confidence to step into roles where they can genuinely make a difference. Their passion for health, fitness, and supporting people shines through every moment.

If you’re someone who loves being active, working with people, and creating positive change, their journey is an awesome example of where this qualification can take you.
